title: It's not just learning. It's transformation.
subtitle: Word of Faith Bible Institute (WOFBI)
quotes: What you don't know, you don't know, and what you won't learn, you won't know. What you don't know, you will pay for it. — Dr. David Oyedepo
There is no mountain anywhere; every man's ignorance is his mountain. — Dr. David Oyedepo
description: The Word of Faith Bible Institute (WOFBI) is a Ministry and Leadership Training Centre, which serves as the training arm of the Living Faith Church Worldwide. The Institute runs periodical three-week specialized courses designed to motivate participants positively towards distinction in their secular and spiritual engagements.
vision: The Vision of the Institute is in line with the mandate given to Dr. David Oyedepo in May 1983: I will through THIS MINISTRY RAISE THE FOUNDATION OF MANY OTHER MINISTRIES.

uiText.quoteHeading: There is no mountain anywhere; every man's ignorance is his mountain.
uiText.introDescription: The Word of Faith Bible Institute [WOFBI] is a Ministry/Leadership Training Centre, which serves as the training arm of the Living Faith Church Worldwide. The Institute runs periodical three weeks specialized courses.
uiText.courseDescription: The courses are designed to motivate participants positively towards distinction both in their secular as well as spiritual engagement.
uiText.visionDescription: The Vision of the Institute is in line with the mandate given to Dr. David Oyedepo in May 1983 when the Holy Ghost said to him, 'I will through THIS MINISTRY RAISE THE FOUNDATION OF MANY OTHER MINISTRIES'. For this reason, the Institute is committed to training leaders for impact.
uiText.historyDescription: The Institute took off September 1, 1986 at Kaduna, Nigeria and has since graduated over 50,000 from the numerous campuses in Nigeria while hundreds have graduated from the Maryland campus.
uiText.address: 8159 W Brown Deer Rd, Milwaukee, WI 53223
uiText.ctaHeading: You were meant to enjoy a life free in Christ.
uiText.ctaSubheading: Take your first step towards it.
uiText.ctaDescription: We exist to bring God's freedom to everyone. We love to care for people who have been hurt. This is our mandate.
